title: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance: policy alert improvements
notes: claim 65: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The dates, default availability, licensing and listed controls are supported. The risk rationale should avoid assuming who receives the new alert emails, and the explanation of email notifications needs one additional citation.

claims.claim: The documented existing behavior sends one email notification every 24 hours for alerts regardless of the number of matching messages.
claims.quote: A single email notification is sent once every 24 hours for any alerts, regardless of the number of individual messages that match policy conditions.

claims.claim: The existing alert policy defaults to simple aggregation.
claims.quote: For Communication Compliance policies, the system configures the following alert policy values by default: | Aggregation | Simple aggregation |

claims.claim: The existing alert policy defaults to a threshold of four activities.

claims.claim: The existing alert policy defaults to a 60-minute window.

claims.claim: The Alert policies page in Microsoft Purview controls trigger activity count, period and specific users for existing Communication Compliance alert policies.
claims.quote: You can change the default settings for triggers on number of activities, period for the activities, and for specific users in alert policies on the Alert policies page in Microsoft Purview.

claims.claim: No documented automation for changing these automatically created Communication Compliance alert policy triggers was found.
claims.quote: Searched: Communication Compliance alert policies triggers threshold PowerShell Set-ProtectionAlert API. Opened Set-ProtectionAlert and communication-compliance-policies; Set-ProtectionAlert excludes default alerts and permits only alerts created with New-ProtectionAlert. No applicable operation found.

claims.claim: No tenant-wide switch for the new alert frequency and recipient settings is documented on either UI or automation surfaces.
claims.quote: Searched: Communication Compliance new alerts page alert frequency email recipients tenant switch disable policy wizard. Opened communication-compliance-configure, communication-compliance-policies and Set-ProtectionAlert; no tenant-wide feature switch found. MC920304 describes default availability.

claims.claim: The cited Communication Compliance policies page names Alert policies but gives no navigation route to that page.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance Alert policies page navigation triggers. Searched the fetched communication-compliance-policies page for Alert policies; it names the page in Manage alert policies but supplies no route to it.

claims.claim: The documented minimum activity threshold for Communication Compliance alert policies is three.
claims.quote: The alert policy threshold trigger settings for activities support a minimum value of 3 or higher for Communication Compliance policies.

claims.claim: Set-ProtectionAlert can modify only alerts created using New-ProtectionAlert, not default alert policies.
claims.quote: You can't use this cmdlet to edit default alert policies. You can only modify alerts that you created using the New-ProtectionAlert cmdlet.

claims.claim: Set-ProtectionAlert is available in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

Reviewer access is documented, but the new email recipients' relationship to reviewers is not.
claims.fix: Remove ', and alerts still go to people working inside Communication Compliance' from the risk rationale. Keep the existing advice to confirm each recipient's entitlement; the notice does not specify who the new email recipients can be.
